title: Magar Kham language - Wikipedia
text: Magar Kham (मगर खाम), also known as Kham, Kham Magar, and Khamkura, is the Sino-Tibetan language variety of the Northern Magar people of Nepal. [3][4][5] The language is situated in the upper elevations of Baglung, East Rukum, and Rolpa districts.
